caption: The drawing depicts a metallic container that is heart-shaped with a slight point at the front and a rounded back. The container has evenly spaced holes throughout its curved sides and base, indicating a perforated design. Its color is mainly a dull, greyish blue, with brownish rust marks and darker mottling suggesting wear and age. The metallic surface reflects light in a muted manner, and the rim, edges, and base display areas of dark brown or reddish rust. There is a single handle attached to the back, which is also colored in the same greyish blue and outlined with darker shading. At the bottom, there are two small ring-shaped feet and a third one may be obscured; each is colored in the same metallic hues with some rust. The background of the drawing is a light beige color and plain, with no other objects or designs present.
title: Pa. German Cheese Strainer
